description: Increase in ridge height with new roof to provide loft accommodation with front dormers, rear dormer, roof lights, roof extension and alterations to first floor front fenestration
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be commenced not later than three years from the date of this permission.
Reason:-
To comply with the requirements of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
All new external finishes shall be carried out in materials to match those of the existing building(s) to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Reason:-
To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.
The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out otherwise than in complete accordance with the approved plans (as set out on page one of this decision notice).
Reason:-
For the avoidance of doubt and to ensure that the development is carried out as approved.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015, no window or other opening (other than those shown on the submitted and approved plan,) shall be formed in the flank wall(s) of the building(s) hereby permitted, unless specific permission under the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 has first been sought and obtained in writing from the Local Planning Authority.
Reason:-
In order to ensure a satisfactory development that will not result in any loss of privacy or damage to the environment of neighbouring properties which exist or may be proposed in the future.

The proposed flank window in the loft serving the en-suite adjacent to No.2 Engayne Gardens, Upminster as shown on drawing nos. AHUB2604004_08 Rev PL03 & AHUB2604004_10 Rev PL03 shall be permanently glazed with obscure glass not less than level 4 on the standard scale of obscurity and shall thereafter be maintained and permanently fixed shut.
Reason:-
In the interests of privacy.

The roof lights/windows on either side of the extended first floor rear extension roof serving the walk in area in the proposed loft as shown on drawing nos. AHUB2604004_08 Rev PL03 & AHUB2604004_10 Rev PL03 shall be obscure-glazed, and  non-opening unless the parts of the window which can be opened are more than 1.7m above the floor of the room in which the window is installed.
Reason - In the interest of privacy and to protect the amenity of the adjacent neighbours

Notwithstanding the details shown on drawing nos. AHUB2604004_09 Rev PL02 & AHUB2604004_10 Rev PL03  accompanying the application, the face and cheeks of the front and rear dormer windows shall be tile hung to match the appearance of the roof of the existing dwelling unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason:-
To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area, and in order that the development accords with Policy 26 of the Havering Local Plan.
UK Power Network Informative
The proposed development is in close proximity to our substations and have the following observations to make:

If the proposed works are located within 6m of the substation, then they are notifiable under the  Party Wall etc. Act 1996. The Applicant should provide details of the proposed works and liaise with the Company to ensure that appropriate protective measures and mitigation solutions are  agreed in accordance with the Act.
The Applicant would need to be responsible for any costs  associated with any appropriate measures required.
Any Party Wall Notice should be served on UK Power Networks at its registered office: UK Power Networks, Newington House, 237 Southwark Bridge Road, London SE1 6NP.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: In accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework, improvements required to make the proposal acceptable were negotiated with Mr Malcolm Clarke (Agent) by phone and email. The revisions involved replacing the proposed gable roof over the existing first floor rear extension with a hipped roof. The amendments were subsequently submitted on 02/09/2026.
